name: Netgear Meural
description: Meural Canvas over the local network. Enter the frame's IP address from its app or router. Tesserae needs no cloud login or firmware changes. It sends the current page as a temporary preview and renews it while running. When Tesserae stops, the frame returns to its own artwork after the preview expires. Quiet hours can put the frame to sleep; Tesserae wakes it afterward only if it put it to sleep. Frames asleep from their own controls or light sensor stay asleep.

host.label: Frame address
host.help: The frame's IP address or host name. Reserve its address in your router.

refresh_interval_s.label: Renew preview every
refresh_interval_s.help: Seconds between local uploads of the current page. This must be shorter than the frame's preview duration, which is often 30 seconds. New pages are sent immediately.
